description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Amendment to SLFRS 3 - Business Combinatios - 01.01.2020
reasoning: This gazette content publishes amendments to the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995, specifically adopting amendments to SLFRS 3 Business Combinations. It constitutes a regulatory framework update for accounting standards, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes.
